faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Health Educator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Health Educator (Technical Support – III) position is 07-08-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Health Educator post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Senior Health Educator (Technical Support – III) at AIIMS Rishikesh as per the released notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year graduate degree in Yoga Therapy with three years of post-qualification experience, or a Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject/field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Health Educator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Health Educator post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Health Educator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 30,800 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Health Educator recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written examination followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Health Educator post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of AIIMS Rishikesh on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment for the Senior Health Educator (Technical Support – III) post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please ensure you read the notification carefully before applying.
